title: changelog needed
body: I'm looking for a changelog in app for nightly releases pre or post update

comments.body: Do you check the Code Commits?

Change log information is here: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commits/master

xDrip is unusual for an Android app that you can simply upgrade and downgrade at will without data loss. Compatibility is maintained over at least a 2 year window. If you have any problem with the newest version, simply reinstall the previous version from your downloads folder. There is no need to uninstall the current version.

The commit log is not really helpful and requires understanding of the code. A "real" changelog would be very useful. Sometimes, code changes fix issues but the commit log does not contain an issue number, i. e. #1635.

Changelog can be as simple as .txt and may be short bw each version with each nightly listed trailing in same txt.
'new features' deserve a line of their own; Bug fixes ot minor changes just write as 'misc bug fixes' 
End user doesnt read code well.

This issue requests for change logs (change logs needed).
The developer clearly explained what is available.

Some may not be happy with that answer.
I see two options.  
Step up and do the work and provide change logs, or we can close this issue.

Can anyone see a third option?  Demanding someone else to work for us is not a reasonable option considering we are all volunteers.
